parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-application-monitor-detect-result --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --task-id sm-bp1fpdjfju9k8yr1y0000 --begin-time 1638288000 --end-time 1640164683 --region cn-hangzhou
